version.kind: latest release listed in the official changelog on the access date
version.documentation_note: Individual documentation pages carry no version or last-updated date; the documentation is treated as unversioned and identified by access date and page hash.

modes: Interactive TUI execution modes: default (request-review), accept-edits, plan
Headless print mode (agy -p) with text, json and stream-json output
Subagents launched by the main agent
profiles.account_and_tier: Personal Google account plans (no Google AI plan, Google AI Pro, Google AI Ultra) or Gemini Enterprise; the Plans page lists the CLI among product features available to all plans. Paid-only commands (for example /boost, /teamwork-preview) are excluded below. Tier for the assessment is a team choice.
exclusions: Antigravity App, Antigravity IDE, IDE extensions and SDK (separate surfaces; claims from their sections do not transfer)
Third-party plugins, MCP servers, skills and custom subagents beyond the native mechanisms (the mechanism is assessed; no add-on is added to the profile)
Gemini Enterprise administrative controls (VPC-SC, data residency, Cloud logging) unless the team selects the enterprise tier
included_components: Native CLI tools, permissions engine, rules, skills, hooks, MCP client, subagents, /plan, /diff, /rewind, /resume, artifact review, headless mode
profiles.interface_and_execution_location: Terminal TUI and headless print mode on the developer workstation; model inference is a hosted service (the docs describe the CLI talking to a shared agent harness and model endpoints).
profiles.instructions_and_permissions: Rules files (AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, .agents/rules/*.md, global ~/.gemini/... and ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/rules/); permissions allow/deny/ask lists in ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json; toolPermission preset (request-review default); artifactReviewPolicy (asks-for-review default).
profiles.model_support: Gemini models listed by `agy models`; some models require paid plans (FAQ). Model choice is not part of the comparison.
